open_obligations.obstruction: After the immediately identifiable root variance, the degree-four test is a large exact symbolic intersection problem. No rank equality proving a proper fixed point and no nullspace witnesses proving full closure are available in the frozen primitives or the presolve evidence.
open_obligations.attempted: The residual missing-edge equations were reduced to the two coupled triangle systems, and the exact degree-four monomial dimensions were computed. The known cancellation of two quadratic cycle equations only gives a higher-degree rational route and does not decide the degree-four recursive intersections, especially after disturbance-coordinate adjunctions.

open_obligations.what_is_open: A matching graph-uniform asymptotic scale for \(D_2(n)\), with a valid rationally identifiable lower family and an upper Hilbert bound controlling the same recursive closure filtration.
open_obligations.obstruction: The prescribed windmill handle fails before the degree argument: its graphs are generically infinite-to-one by a source-versus-observation dimension count. The frozen core contains neither a replacement identifiable family nor a graph-uniform closure theorem, so promoting either missing crux to a hypothesis would assume the result being sought.
open_obligations.attempted: The windmill edge and parameter counts were audited exactly, the three-vertex frontier was independently recomputed by rational row reduction, and the closure characterization was proved. These routes yield the finite base and an order-free test but no asymptotic collision after the proposed family is excluded.
